profile_text.body:
Amazon is a for-profit public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States. Its website is amazon.com. No further description of the company's own operations was available from its site text for this profile.

Four MCP servers are recorded in connection with Amazon. ai.sellermate/amazon-ads is described as a remote MCP with OAuth, free to connect, that lets a user ask an Amazon Ads account anything and act with guardrails. ai.trendsapi/amazon is described as providing Amazon product search volume and best-seller trends, with a free key available at trendsapi.ai. ai.trendsmcp/amazon is described as providing Amazon product search demand over time, with growth for any keyword, and a free key at trendsmcp.ai. app.apiguru/amazon-data is described as providing live Amazon product, review, search, deal, offer and stock, and seller data across 20 marketplaces.

On litigation, the record includes a case named Haugland v. Anthropic PBC, filed in the District Court, D. Delaware. A separate litigation exposure count of 114 is recorded for Washington.
